name: Earthrift
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level bloodrager 3, druid 3, magus 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target line up to close range (see above)

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You unleash a resonance into the ground in a line causing it to burst upward in a line. All creatures in the line must make a Reflex save or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). A successful Reflex save halves this damage. The line cannot cross wood floors or open air.
